notes:
Type a word and watch it react to the music, with block, grid, slice, glitch and scroll modes and live Syphon output for your VJ rig.

This version has a cleaner interface and one click auto updates. It now lives in its own release home.

First launch: open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, and click Open Anyway. You need an Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
